name: Ayase-ke no Onna ~Inka no Ketsumyaku~
original_name: 綾瀬家のオンナ～淫華の血脈～
source:
Two sisters Mizuki Ayase and Hinata Ayase have transferred to a rural school. There is a secret about them that they stimulate sexual arousal in men unconsciously. Classmates and teachers become captivated by them. School girls become jealous and start to harass newcomers, and school plunges into chaos.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
绫濑美月与绫濑日向两姐妹一同转学来到一所偏僻的乡村学园。姐妹二人身怀一桩不为人知的秘密——她们的体质会无意识地催发男性的强烈情欲。转眼之间，班上的男生与男教师纷纷拜倒在姐妹俩的石榴裙下；而心生嫉恨的女生们则开始联手欺凌这两名转校生，整座学园顿时陷入一片混乱。
